text: Early first quarter, no score. Buffalo's opening drive stalls at midfield.
The punt pins Cleveland at its own 5.
From their own 5, the Browns grind into Buffalo territory.
Gordon's 13-yard catch takes Cleveland to the Buffalo 9.
Stopped at the 4, Cleveland takes the field goal. 3-0.
Buffalo answers with a drive to the Cleveland 7.
Third and 6: Leonhard intercepts Orton in the end zone.
Cleveland still leads 3-0, and the second quarter stays scoreless.
Both defences own the half: three points in thirty minutes.
Browns driving before the half. Searcy picks off Hoyer instead.
One second left in the half. A 53-yard try, blocked.
Third play of the second half: Haden intercepts Orton at the 30.
Fourth and 3, down 3-0: Orton finds Woods deep, to the 3.
Hogan's touchdown gives Buffalo its first lead of the day.
Cleveland's first snap after the kickoff: West fumbles, Hughes takes it in.
Two touchdowns in four seconds of game clock. Buffalo 14, Cleveland 3.
Three straight punts, then Carpenter from 49 makes it 17-3.
Up 14 in the fourth, Buffalo gets Searcy's second interception.
A short field from the 21: another Carpenter field goal. 20-3.
Manziel, now at quarterback, scrambles in. Still two scores down.
Buffalo answers with eight runs in nine plays, then kicks.
Cleveland's last chance ends on downs at its own 23.
Carpenter's fourth field goal closes it out: 26-10.
